title: Explain the ambiguity wait when changed command or place retires a full-launch check
outcome: A holder is told that its full-launch check was retired and why an immediate relaunch may be refused as ambiguous.
acceptance: When a recognized full-launch check is retired because a repeated start or command description changes its command or place, the holder receives one truthful check-credit notice identifying the original check fingerprint, original start and command-or-place change.

The notice explains that the old launch may already have started a run and states the existing two-minute ambiguity wait; matching repeated starts and ordinary-test retirements create no new full-launch-retirement notice or ambiguity window, and credit/retirement policy is unchanged.

Deterministic recorder regressions cover both retirement routes through the actual ACP update ordering, verify one notice per retired check with the original identity and time, retain later-carry refusal, and include matching and ordinary-test controls.

Focused validation and an independent Codex/Claude review pair cover the exact input with no outstanding in-scope Medium or higher; Merger owns the final combined carry audit, exact Windows full gate and fresh independent acceptance before landing.
